text:
Type: faux fur throw blanket
Use: warmth and layering on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: glam, contemporary, rustic
Materials: plush faux fur, sculpted pile
Colors: frost grey, charcoal, warm taupe mottling
Shape: large rectangle, wavy sculpted fur pattern like pelts, thick plush pile, heavy drape, bulky
Feel: luxurious, cozy, warm, enveloping
Goes with: blush, cream or grey upholstery, tufted furniture, neutral walls; glam or lodge-style living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: Pinzon Faux Fur Throw Blanket - 63 x 87 Inch, Frost Grey
product.description: Faux fur throw for sumptuous softness and a luxurious layer of cozy warmth About 1/2-inch thick on one side and velvety soft fabric on the reverse Made of 100% polyester; faux fur, so it’s animal friendly (no animals harmed) Individually dyed, creating natural variations in the color—no 2 are exactly the same Frost Grey color for neutral, yet sophisticated beauty; measures 63 by 87 inches Made in OEKO-TEX Standard 100 factory, an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards.
